title: Neurobiology
description: Grow a brain in a dish and ask it what it thinks. Unlocks neural organoids.

puzzle.goal: Ions of valence z and concentration C(x) cross a cell membrane. They drift down their concentration gradient with diffusion constant D, and are also pushed by the electric field from the membrane potential V(x). Write the ion flux j as the sum of both effects, using the thermal energy per mole RT and the charge per mole zF.
puzzle.name: Nernst–Planck equation (electrodiffusion flux)
puzzle.form: - D * ( d ( C , x ) + z * F / ( R * T ) * C * d ( V , x ) )
puzzle.expr: R * T / F * ln ( Ci / Co )
puzzle.ask: Setting j = 0 and integrating across the membrane gives the equilibrium potential; for K⁺ (z = 1) its magnitude is (RT/F)·ln(C_in/C_out). Find it in volts at T = @{T} K with @{Ci} mM inside and 5 mM outside.
puzzle.method: Fick's diffusion term −D dC/dx plus electrical drift whose mobility is related to D by the thermal energy RT.
